decision: A sandbox-local UDP subset is implemented on a distinct per-kernel packet transport. It cannot reach operating-system or external UDP.
truthfulLocalSurface: bind to a sandbox-local address and virtual port
atomic send delivery without stream connection state
message events with copied payload and virtual rinfo
addMembership and dropMembership for sandbox-local virtual multicast groups
membershipBoundary: Membership can be truthful only as membership in a per-kernel virtual multicast group. Interface selection must be omitted or use a documented virtual interface. Source-specific membership requires separate group and source routing state before it can be exposed.
mustReject: broadcast to host or LAN interfaces
source-specific membership until virtual source routing exists
architecture: VirtualDatagramNetwork is owned by the kernel worker and is separate from VirtualNetwork streams. It provides endpoint bind tables, ephemeral ports, copied atomic packet queues, virtual rinfo, process-owner cleanup, reference tracking and virtual multicast membership sets.
